display.purpose: Poppins. Brand wordmark and login title only — never app chrome.

numeric.purpose: The signature figure. 34px tabular-nums, right-aligned. The number the product exists to show.

headline.purpose: Report totals — the 'trust the numbers' figure. 800 weight, tabular.

body.purpose: Default text. Entry descriptions run heavier (700, 15.5px).

label.purpose: Day headers, summary labels, badges. Uppercase, 11.5px, 0.5px tracking.

shadows.name: glass-ambient
shadows.purpose: Resting state of every glass panel — navy-tinted diffuse shadow plus bright top highlight.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Entry rows and interactive cards on hover, paired with translateY(-1px).

shadows.name: running-glow
shadows.purpose: The timer card while actively tracking. Amber variant (229,162,60) when paused.

shadows.name: action-shadow
shadows.purpose: Colored soft shadow under circular timer buttons, tinted to the button's own hue.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover/active state changes on buttons, links, entries.

motion.name: surface-shift
motion.purpose: Timer card border/shadow transitions between neutral, running, and paused.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Tactile press feedback on circular timer transport controls.

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: The live tracking pulse dot ring expansion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The primary action — solid Clear-Sky Blue, used sparingly (≤10% of a screen).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2f6df6; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1f5be0; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f6df6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The default secondary action — translucent glass with a frosted edge.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); color: #16324f; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.75); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(12px); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(12px); transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f6df6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Timer Start
components.description: The signature transport control — a 48px green circle. Becomes a red stop circle while running.
components.html: <button class="ds-timer-start" aria-label="Start timer"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-timer-start { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; cursor: pointer; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(160deg,#2fd07a,#22b56a); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(43,182,115,0.4); transition: transform 0.12s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-timer-start:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(43,182,115,0.5); } .ds-timer-start:active { transform: scale(0.92); } .ds-timer-start:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #16324f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Range / filter / grouping pill. Translucent when resting, solid Clear-Sky Blue when active.
components.css: .ds-chip { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.75); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); color: #5d7793; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-chip:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); color: #16324f; } .ds-chip--active { background: #2f6df6; color: #fff; border-color: #2f6df6; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f6df6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: The core surface primitive — every panel is a frosted pane floating on the sky.
components.html:
Today
6h 42m tracked across 4 projects.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(18px); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(18px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.75); box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(31,73,125,0.16), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9); border-radius: 18px; padding: 18px; color: #16324f; } .ds-card__title { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; color: #5d7793; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-card__body { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.45; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Translucent field with a frosted edge; border shifts to Clear-Sky Blue on focus (no heavy glow).

components.description: Team identity pill — color is always paired with a text label and a leading dot, never hue alone.

narrative.overview: TimeIT is Apple-style translucency lit by daylight: soft, frosted surfaces floating on a calm sky-blue field, with sharp typographic hierarchy carrying the data. The glass is the material; precision is the voice. Density serves speed — this is a tool people keep open all day, so layouts are compact and information-rich rather than airy, and the primary action on every screen is never in doubt. Color is rationed: the surface is atmosphere, and saturated color appears only to signal action, state, or team identity. The system explicitly rejects employee-surveillance aesthetics and heavy enterprise-timesheet chrome; feedback is calm and never nags.
keyCharacteristics: Frosted liquid-glass panels on a fixed daylight sky-blue gradient
Soft, tactile, rounded surfaces (18px / 12px radii, full pills for actions)
Sharp, tabular-numeral data hierarchy on top of the soft glass
Restrained color: one accent for action/state, semantic green/amber/red, two team hues
Calm, quiet feedback — never surveillance, never gamification

rules.name: The Rationed-Color Rule
rules.body: Clear-Sky Blue appears on ≤10% of any screen. The sky is atmosphere; the accent is action. If a screen looks blue-on-blue-on-blue, the accent has stopped meaning 'act here.'

rules.name: The One-Meaning Rule
rules.body: Green means running. Amber means paused. Red means stop/destroy. Coral means Sales, violet means Ops. A semantic color is never borrowed for decoration.

rules.name: The Tabular-Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number that represents time uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Figures must not jitter as they tick. It is the difference between a stopwatch and a toy.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: The system sans carries headings, buttons, labels, body, and data. Poppins is brand chrome only. Never introduce a third family.

rules.name: The Frosted-Not-Flat Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from the blur and the inner highlight, never from a dark or hard drop shadow. Remove the backdrop-filter and the panel should look broken, not merely flatter.

dos: Do keep Clear-Sky Blue (#2f6df6) to ≤10% of any screen — it means 'act here / this is selected,' nothing else.
Do use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every time figure — readouts, durations, totals.
Do build depth from the frosted blur + bright inner highlight, with a soft navy-tinted ambient shadow (0 8px 30px rgba(31,73,125,0.16)).
Do pair every team/status color with a text label or badge, so color-blind users never rely on hue alone.
Do keep the daylight gradient background-attachment: fixed — the glass floats on a stable sky.
Do map each semantic color to exactly one meaning: green=running, amber=paused, red=stop/destroy.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion for the pulse dot, entry fade-ins, and view transitions.
donts: Don't drift toward employee-surveillance aesthetics — no activity scores, streaks, idle-shaming, or screenshots.
Don't adopt heavy enterprise-timesheet chrome — no dense gray form-grids, no approval-gated wizards, no legacy-ERP density.
Don't ship the generic purple-gradient SaaS dashboard or the hero-metric template.
Don't use background-clip: text gradient text, or a border-left/border-right colored stripe as an accent.
Don't use glassmorphism as decoration elsewhere — here it is the system material, applied consistently.
Don't use Poppins for UI labels, buttons, or data — it is brand chrome only.
Don't let muted-slate (#5d7793) body text sit on the most transparent glass where it drops below 4.5:1.
Don't use a hard/dark drop shadow — if it looks like a 2014 app, the blur is missing and the shadow is too dark.
